desc.en: The following is quoted from the book of Zad al-Ma’ad by Allamah Majlisi. It is highly advisable not to neglect mentioning the dead, because they are now too short to do any righteous or charitable deed. They therefore hope that their sons, relatives, and brethren in-faith will do charitable acts on behalf of them or pray for them, especially at the night-time prayers. An individual is required to pray for his parents in the post-prayer supplicatory utterances and at visiting the holy shrines and to do charitable and righteous acts on behalf of them.
desc.rurdu: Allama Majlisi ne Zaad al-Maad mein farmaya hai keh marne waalo’n ko faraamosh nahi karna chaahiye kyu-keh woh khud to amaal-e-khair anjaam nahi de paate woh sirf apni aulaad, rishte-daaro’n aur momin bhaiyyo’n se aas lagaaye huwe hai aur unki nekiyo’n ke liye chashm barah hai, pas khaas taur par Namaz-e-Shab, waajib namazo’n ke baad aur maqaamaate muqaddasa ki ziyarat ke mauqe par un ke liye dua karna chahiye aur waaledain ke liye dusro’n se kuchh ziyadah dua karna chahiye neez unke liye amaal-e-khair baja laane chahiye.
desc.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

desc.en: A tradition holds that an individual who may be impious to his parents can be recorded as pious to them after their death when he does charitable and righteous acts on behalf of them; while an individual who is pious to his parents in their lifetimes may be decided as impious to them after their death, because he disregards doing any charitable or righteous act on behalf of them. The best charitable favor that is done to one’s parents or relatives is to settle their debts and to release them from any liability towards Almighty Allah or towards other people. Hence, one may do his best to go on the ritual pilgrimage (Hajj) on behalf of the dead or to make up for the obligatory acts of worship that they missed to do, either voluntarily or by employing someone to do that for a certain wage.
desc.rurdu: Ek aur riwaayat mein aaya hai keh bohot se aulaade’n aisi hoti hai keh waaledain ki maujoodgi mein unki na-farmaan hoti hai lekin unke marne ke baad unke liye amaale khair baja laane ke baais farma’n bardaar ban jaati hai aur usi tarah bohot se aulaade’n aisi hai jo waaledain ki zindagi mein unki farmaan-bardaar hoti hai lekin unke marne ke baad unke liye amaale khair baja na laane ya kam baja laane se na-farmaan ho jaati hai. Apne marhoom waaledain aur rishte-daaro’n ke liye sab se behtar aur umdah neki yeh hai keh unke waajib qarze adaa kiye jaaye aur unhe huqooqullah aur huqooqul ebaad se chhut-kaara dilaaya jaaye aur un par Hajj ya dusri ibaadat ki jo adaayegi waajib thi who khud ya ujrat de kar adaa karaayi jaaye.

desc.en: In this respect, an authentic tradition holds that Imam Sadiq (a) used to offer <Namaz-e-Aafiyat> each night on behalf of his son and another 2 rakats namaz on behalf of his parents.
desc.rurdu: Sahih hadees mein manqool hai keh Hazrat Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) har shab apne farzand ke liye aur har roz apne waaledain ke liye <Namaz-e-Aafiyat> padha karte thay.

desc.en: Another authentic tradition holds that Imam Sadiq (a) said, “It happens that the tight grave of a dead is expanded for him. He is then informed that this expansion has been made due to the prayer of your brother-in-faith, so and so, for you.” The reporter asked, “Is it permissible to dedicate 2 rakats namaz to 2 dead persons?” The Imam (a) answered, “Yes, it is. Indeed, a dead person takes pleasure in the prayers and forgiveness-seeking implorations that are dedicated to him just as a living person feels happy when a present is gifted to him. The reward of such act is recorded for both the dead and the dedicating person.”
desc.rurdu: Imam Sadiq (a) se yeh bhi manqool hai keh baaz awqaat yu hota hai keh ek mayyit tangi aur sakhti mein hoti hai lekin Allah (swt) usey asaaish o kashaaish ataa kar deta hai phir mayyit se kaha jaata hai tujhe yeh aasaani is liye mayassar huwi keh tere fulaan momin bhai ne tere liye namaz padhi hai. Raawi ne poochha aaya ek namaz mein do (2) mayyato’n ko bhi shareek kiya ja sakta hai? Farmaaya haa’n, aisa kiya ja sakta hai phir farmaaya keh mayyit ko khushi haasil hoti hai aur woh dua aur isteghfaar ki wajah se masroor hoti hai jo uske liye ki jaati hai usey waise hi khushi milti hai jaise zindah shakhs ko hadiye se khushi hoti hai.

desc.en: According to another tradition, Imam Sadiq (a) said, “Prayers, fasting, going on Hajj, alms-giving, charitable acts, and duas, these things join the dead in his grave.”
desc.rurdu: Neez farmaaya keh mayyit ke liye namaz, roze, Hajj, sadqaat, dusre jo bhi amaale khair baja laaye aur uske liye dua ki jaaye un tamaam cheezo’n ka sawaab qabr mein uske paas pohonch jaate hai yeh sawaab mayyit ke liye bhi likkha jaata hai aur mayyit ke liye amaal baja laane waale shakhs ke liye bhi likkha jaata hai.

desc.en: According to another tradition, Imam Sadiq (a) said, “Any Muslim who does a (righteous) act on behalf of a dead, Almighty Allah will double his reward and make his act beneficial for the dead.”
desc.rurdu: Ek aur hadees mein farmaate hai keh jo musalmaan kisi marne waale ke liye koi nek amal anjaam deta hai Allah uske sawaab ko dugna (double) kar deta hai aur marne waala us se faayeda uthaata rehta hai.

desc.en: Other traditions hold that when one gives something as alms on behalf of a dead, Almighty Allah will order Archangel Gabriel to lead 70000 angels to the grave of that dead, each angel carrying a saucer and saying to the dead, “Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant. This is the gift of so and so, the faithful, to you.” The grave of that dead will then glitter. Moreover, Almighty Allah will give him 1000 cities in Paradise, 1000 Paradisiacal women in marriage, 1000 garments to dress, and will grant him 1000 of his requests.
desc.rurdu: Ek aur riwaayat mein hai keh jab koi shakhs kisi marne waale ko sawaab pohoncha ne ke liye sadqa karta hai to Allah (swt) Hazrat Jibraeel (a) ko hukm deta hai to woh 70000 farishto’n ke saath uski qabr par jaate hai jin mein se har ek haath mein neymate ilaahi ka tabqa hota hai, har farishte usko “Assalaamo alaika ya Wali Allah” kehta hai aur baata hai keh ay Khuda ke bande tumhaare liye yeh hadiya fula’n momin ne bheja hai. Uski qabr munawwar ho jaati hai aur Allah (swt) behisht (Jannat) mein uske 1000 shaher ataa farmaayega, 1000 hooro’n se uska aqd (nikah) karaayega, usey 1000 poshaaki (garments) pehnaayega aur uski 1000 haajaat puri farmaayega.
